findings.evidence: lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window
findings.rationale: Specifies locking the account upon 5 consecutive failed logins, but omits the lockout timeout duration and the recovery/unlock procedure.

findings.evidence: notify him by email
findings.rationale: The pronoun 'him' has multiple plausible antecedents (the Librarian, the Member, or the Guarantor), leaving the email recipient ambiguous.

findings.evidence: TBD minutes
findings.rationale: Uses an unresolved 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the concrete expiration duration for password-reset tokens.

findings.evidence: user-friendly; easy to navigate; loads rapidly; standard connections
findings.rationale: Relies on subjective, unquantified terms ('user-friendly', 'easy to navigate', 'loads rapidly', 'standard connections') with no measurable acceptance criteria.

findings.evidence: at most TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: Uses an unresolved 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the maximum number of consecutive loan renewals.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: Specifies only the happy path for self-checkout validation without defining system behavior when the item is ineligible or the barcode scan fails.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: References a cap on active hold requests without providing the actual numeric limit.

findings.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: Allows a Member in good standing to borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously, conflicting with SD-009 which caps simultaneous checkouts at 5 physical items.

findings.evidence: standard loan period for circulating print books to 21 calendar days
findings.rationale: Sets the standard loan period for circulating print books to 21 calendar days, conflicting with SD-010 which sets it to 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
findings.rationale: Permits unverified visitors to self-register with only an email and check out books without ID verification, directly contradicting SD-001 which requires a Librarian to verify government-issued photo ID and record full name, email, and phone number.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: Requires reserved items on the pickup shelf to remain held indefinitely until explicitly canceled by the Member, conflicting with SD-011 which automatically cancels uncollected holds after 72 hours.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Stacked 'and/or' connectives leave it ambiguous which combination of the three actions must be executed when an item is 7 days overdue.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded with a reason code in the audit log
findings.rationale: Uses passive voice without identifying which role or system component (e.g., Librarian, Administrator, or Billing Service) is responsible for reviewing, approving, and recording waiver requests.

findings.evidence: before the due date if appropriate
findings.rationale: The non-binding qualifier 'if appropriate' makes SMS alert dispatch subjective and untestable, and 'before the due date' gives no measurable lead time.

findings.evidence: TBD years
findings.rationale: Uses an unresolved 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the retention period for payment receipts.

findings.evidence: $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap on accumulated fines
findings.rationale: Specifies an overdue fine rate of $1.25 USD/day with no cap, conflicting with SD-019 which specifies $0.50 USD/day capped at $20.00 USD per item.

findings.evidence: permitted to renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: Allows Members to renew borrowed items regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance, directly contradicting SD-020 which blocks renewals when unpaid fines exceed $5.00 USD.

findings.evidence: Patron's active loan count; Patron profile screen
findings.rationale: Uses the term 'Patron' for the library borrower role instead of the established term 'Member' used across earlier requirements such as SD-001 and SD-009.

findings.evidence: quickly; many users
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms 'quickly' and 'many users' without specifying a maximum response time or concurrent user load.

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: The non-binding qualifier 'where possible' makes query term highlighting optional and prevents objective verification.

findings.evidence: sufficient ISBN matching accuracy; acceptable response times
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified adjectives 'sufficient' and 'acceptable' without specifying measurable accuracy or latency thresholds.

findings.evidence: efficiently; large batch MARC21 files; without noticeable system slowdown
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms 'efficiently', 'large', and 'noticeable system slowdown' with no measurable throughput, file-size, or performance degradation thresholds.

findings.evidence: the Catalog Service shall detect the active references
findings.rationale: Specifies detecting active loans or holds when deletion is attempted, but omits the resulting system action (e.g., blocking deletion and returning an error).

findings.evidence: TBD intervals
findings.rationale: Uses an unresolved 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the concrete backup schedule interval.

findings.evidence: important administrative actions; in a timely manner; for an appropriate period
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms ('important', 'timely manner', 'appropriate period') without enumerating the audited actions or specifying latency and retention durations.

findings.evidence: If the primary database node becomes unreachable for more than 10 seconds, the Failover Manager shall log event FAILOVER-01
findings.rationale: Specifies only logging an event upon primary database unreachability without defining the failover or recovery actions to restore database availability.

findings.evidence: adequate transport security; clear error messages
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms 'adequate' and 'clear' without specifying concrete security protocols/standards or required error message content.

findings.evidence: accept any Member password of at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: Accepts any Member password of at least 8 characters, conflicting with SD-002 which enforces a minimum of 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numeric complexity requirements.

findings.evidence: keep authenticated web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: Keeps web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of inactivity, conflicting with SD-004 which terminates sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve forgotten passwords
findings.rationale: Requires reversible AES-256 encryption so passwords can be decrypted, directly contradicting SD-003 which mandates one-way bcrypt hashing (cost factor 12) and forbids storing or logging plaintext passwords.
